body.en: Your household wants to prepare for a harder rainy season this year, but you only have a small budget. What's the most effective first step?

choices.label: Clear and repair the drainage channel around the house before the rains start
choices.consequence: Good instinct. Most flood damage to homes in low-lying areas comes from blocked or broken drainage right at the property, not just heavy rain itself — fixing that first gives you the most protection for the least money.

choices.label: Wait and see if it actually floods before spending anything
choices.consequence: Costly gamble. Drainage repairs are far cheaper done before a flood than the cleanup and losses after one.

choices.label: Spend the whole budget on a generator instead
choices.consequence: Wrong priority. A generator doesn't protect your home from flood damage — it solves a different problem than the one you're actually facing this rainy season.
